Name: DKT Connectome Pipeline
Description: QSIPrep → optional lesion inpainting (neuroLIT) → FreeSurfer/FastSurfer → QSIRecon ACT-HSVS tractography → DKT structural connectome → optional disconnectome (Step 4.5) → node-strength report.
Author: University of Rochester Medical Center
HowToAcknowledge: Please cite QSIPrep (Cieslak et al., Nature Methods 2021), QSIRecon (Cieslak et al., bioRxiv 2024), FreeSurfer/FastSurfer, MRtrix3, Pollak et al. 2025 (neuroLIT) when inpainting, Griffis et al. 2019 (Cell Reports) for disconnectome, and Gorgolewski et al. 2016 (BIDS). Full per-step references: https://dkt-connectome.readthedocs.io/en/latest/references/
